p: sons of Joseph the son of: Because they were made two tribes, they had a double portion.
the chief ruler: That is, he was the chiefest of all the tribes according to Jacob's prophecy, Ge 49:8, and because Christ would come from him.
carried away captive: That is, in the time of Uzziah king of Israel, 2Ki 15:23.
Aroer: These places were beyond Jordan toward the east in the land given to the Reubenites.
Hagarites: The Ishmaelites who came from Hagar Abraham's concubine.
Bashan: Both the whole country and one particular city were called Bashan.
Jetur: These twelve were the sons of Ishmael, Ge 25:15.
helped against them: That is, by the Lord who gave them the victory.
captivity: Meaning, the captivity of the ten tribes under Tiglath Pileser.
Baalhermon and Senir: Otherwise called Baal-gad.
stirred up the spirit of Pul: Thus God stirred up the wicked and used them as instruments to execute his just judgment against sinners, although they were led by malice and ambition.
